fact: The sector strategic plan dated October 2024, covering 2024/25-2028/29 and aligned to NST2, commits to upgraded e-justice systems such as IECMS, makes the Ministry of Justice responsible for keeping IECMS hosted, maintained and its end users trained in every year of the plan, and assigns RIB the update of IECMS with e-signature and online complaint.
title: Justice, Reconciliation, Law & Order Sector Strategic Plan 2024/25-2028/29
